transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi… thanks for seeing me. I guess I’m here because things have felt a little… unusually intense lately. I just moved into a new apartment and I was barely even settled, but then I suddenly started saying yes to mentoring sessions, taking on extra client prototype work, and redesigning my whole portfolio.

At first it felt productive, like I was finally getting my life together, but it’s kind of like I decided I had to fix everything in one sprint. I don’t know if that makes sense, or if I’m overreacting, but it felt like maybe I should talk to someone.
Have you been feeling unusually happy or excited lately?

Yeah… I think so. Not like happy in a normal “good mood” way, exactly, but earlier this month I felt kind of electric—really upbeat, like everything was suddenly possible.

And then, um… it would flip pretty fast. I’d get irritated over tiny things, like if a contractor was delayed or my sister didn’t respond the way I expected, I’d snap more than I should have. I’m not proud of that. It just felt in the moment like they were blocking me, even though I know that probably sounds a bit much.
Have you been feeling like you're capable of accomplishing more than you normally can?

Um… I don’t know if I’d put it that strongly. Maybe a little? It felt more like I was motivated and had a lot of ideas, not like I thought I could do anything impossible.

I mean, I did feel unusually confident, I guess, but I’m not sure where the line is between being productive and… being unrealistic. Does that answer what you mean?
Have you been having trouble sleeping lately?

A little, yeah. I mean, I’m still getting some sleep, so I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is… but lately I’ll either lie there replaying everything I think I messed up, or I wake up around four in the morning because of the traffic outside and then my brain just won’t quiet down again.

I’m not sure if that counts as “trouble sleeping,” but it’s been happening enough that I’ve noticed it.
Have you been having trouble focusing on one thing for a long time?

I’m not sure… I don’t think it’s been a huge problem, exactly. I mean, with design work I’m used to switching between things, so it’s hard to tell what’s normal for me.

Maybe I’ve been a little more scattered at times, but I can still get things done if I really sit myself down. Is that the kind of focusing you mean?
Have you been feeling guilty about anything lately?

Yeah… a bit. I mean, I know some of it is probably just me being hard on myself, but I keep going over things and thinking I ruined the separation, or wasted money I shouldn’t have, or let clients down.

And then it kind of turns into this bigger thing, like every practical problem somehow got worse because of me… because of who I am, I guess. That sounds dramatic when I say it out loud, sorry. But yes, I’ve been feeling guilty.
Have you been feeling sad or empty most of the day?

Yeah… I think so. I don’t want to overstate it, because it’s not like I’m crying nonstop or anything, but lately I wake up with this kind of heavy, gray feeling in my chest.

And even if the apartment is quiet and nothing is actually wrong in that moment, I’ll feel like I could cry over something stupid, like a coffee mug left in the sink. I know that sounds silly, but… yeah, it’s been there a lot of the day.
How long have you been experiencing these mood swings?

I guess… about a month? It really started feeling like this intense up-and-down thing after I moved into the apartment.

I don’t know if that’s the right way to measure it, but since then it’s been more noticeable. Before that, I had normal stressful days, but this pattern has felt more… consistent since the move.
Have you ever had a period of time where you didn't need much sleep and still felt rested?

Um… yes, I think so. Not all the time, but there were several nights where I only slept maybe three or four hours, and I’d wake up feeling like I was fine—like, weirdly rested enough.

I kind of told myself it was productive, like I should use the extra hours to get ahead on things. I know that probably doesn’t sound great, but at the time it felt… reasonable? Like I didn’t feel exhausted the way I normally would.
Have you experienced any thoughts or heard any voices that seemed real but weren't?

Um… no, I don’t think so. I mean, I get in my head sometimes and overthink things, but I haven’t heard voices or seen things that other people didn’t seem to see.

At least not that I’ve noticed. Is that what you mean?
Have you been taking on more projects or activities than you usually would?

Yeah… I mean, I wouldn’t say it was totally out of control, but yes, more than usual.

After I moved into the new apartment, I went from barely feeling settled to suddenly saying yes to mentoring sessions, taking on extra client prototypes, and deciding I needed to redesign my whole portfolio. It kind of felt like I had to fix my entire life in one sprint, if that makes sense.

At the time it felt productive… but looking back, it was probably a lot.
Have you been feeling like you're more important or special than you normally do?

I don’t think so… not in the sense of feeling like I’m better than other people or, like, destined for something huge.

I might have felt more confident than usual at times, but I wouldn’t say “special” exactly. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you had a period where you felt extremely happy or euphoric, beyond what would be expected from your normal reactions to good news or positive events?

Yeah… I think so, though I don’t know if I’d call it “euphoric,” exactly. Earlier this month there were moments where I felt almost… electric, like really upbeat and switched on, more than made sense.

But it wasn’t all positive. I’d be feeling great one minute, and then I’d snap at a contractor or my sister over some tiny delay, like they were personally trying to block me. Which sounds worse when I say it out loud… but yes, I guess it was more intense than my normal reaction.
Do you find that your high-energy, upbeat periods are usually followed by the low, sad periods, or do they seem to happen more randomly?

I’m not totally sure, honestly. I haven’t tracked it closely enough to say there’s a clear pattern.

It feels like sometimes I have those higher-energy stretches and then later I’ll feel low, but I don’t know if it’s really a “this always follows that” kind of thing, or if I’m just noticing it after the fact. I don’t want to overstate it.

Would it help if I started writing it down or something?
Do you usually feel a crash or a low period after your high-energy, upbeat moments?

Usually, yes… I think there is kind of a crash afterward. I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, but lately I’ll wake up with this heavy, gray feeling in my chest.

Even if the apartment is quiet and nothing bad is actually happening, I can feel like I might cry over something stupid, like a coffee mug left in the sink. I know that probably sounds small, but it feels really heavy in the moment.
How long do these high-energy, upbeat periods typically last?

Um… I think it’s been happening in this kind of up-and-down way since I moved into the apartment, so about a month ago.

The high-energy parts themselves don’t feel like one solid block the whole month, if that makes sense, but this pattern has been going on around that long. Is that the kind of timeframe you mean?
Have you experienced these intense mood swings before in your life, or is this the first time?

I don’t think it’s been like this before, not this intense anyway. The whole up-and-down pattern really seems to have started since I moved into the apartment, so… about a month ago.

I mean, I’ve had normal mood stuff before, like anyone, but this feels more noticeable. I hope that answers what you’re asking.
Have you had periods like this before in your life, where you experienced similar intense mood swings?

I think… not really like this before. I mean, I’ve had ups and downs like anyone, but this whole intense pattern has really only been happening since I moved into the apartment, about a month ago. I hope that makes sense—I don’t want to overstate it.
Have you ever had a period of time where you felt extremely happy, irritable, or had a lot of energy, that lasted for at least several days?

Yeah… I think earlier this month there were stretches like that. I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, but I felt almost, like, electric sometimes—really upbeat—and then I’d suddenly get irritated over something small.

Like I snapped at a contractor, and at my sister, over tiny delays. At the time it felt like they were somehow blocking me on purpose, even though… looking back, I know that’s probably not fair. Does that count as what you mean by several days?
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely happy, irritable, or had a lot of energy that lasted for at least several days and was distinct from your normal mood?

Yes, I think so. Earlier this month there were a few days where I felt… almost electric, like really upbeat and energized, more than my usual self. But it wasn’t all positive—I’d also get irritated really fast.

I snapped at a contractor and at my sister over these tiny delays, like in the moment it felt like they were personally trying to block me. I know that probably sounds a little unreasonable now, but at the time it felt very real. So yes, I’d say it was distinct from my normal mood.
